description: The last 7, 30 or 90 days at a named place in India, a day at a time: the day's air (the middle of the stations within 25 km, each by its worst reading; measured), its highest and lowest feels-like temperature, rain, strongest gust, highest UV, lowest visibility and dust (modelled, Open-Meteo), and fires seen by satellite within 100 km (NASA FIRMS). Each hazard comes with its days at each level (low, moderate, high, severe) and its peak, in the order of risk, the same as the place's trends page. Limits: named places only (mugilu's 793 districts and cities; a coordinate borrows the nearest one within 25 km, and says how far); the record starts 22 Aug 2026, so nothing before that; at most 90 days; daily summaries, not hourly readings. Surface the returned `attribution` and `disclaimer`.

place.description: A named place ("Delhi", "Almora") or a coordinate "lat,lon" (the nearest named place within 25 km).
